cannot: No dataset and no computer simulation can prove NCU. The swarm data is simulated; the LMD numbers are measurements of a pseudo-inverse. What is done here is abstraction of computational telemetry into metaphorical representation to illustrate a governance philosophy — one direction, and no evidential weight in either.

nafs.note: These are philosophy-layer terms. They describe no measured quantity, index no dataset, and are never computed with. A test fails if any of them appears in a measurement module.

abstractions.measured: Scaling every coupling by the same factor rescales every distance and changes nothing else: slope −0.5, R² 1.000000, on every graph.
abstractions.figure: Turning every lamp in a room up together changes how bright the room is and nothing about where anything sits.
abstractions.illustrates: A uniform change in intensity is not a change in structure. Effort applied evenly to everything moves the whole scene and rearranges none of it.

abstractions.measured: Raising the coupling on ONE link moves the nearest elements most, and the effect falls off monotonically with hop distance.
abstractions.figure: Pulling one thread in a net: what is knotted to it moves a lot, the next ring moves less, the far edge barely stirs.
abstractions.illustrates: A particular attention has a reach, and the reach is finite and graded. It is not the same act as turning everything up.

abstractions.measured: Two elements with no path between them come back from the raw pseudo-inverse at a FINITE distance (1.118) — nearer than a real distance inside one piece (1.732). The engine has to detect the break itself and return infinity.
abstractions.figure: Two rooms with no door between them, and a tape measure that still reports a short distance because it went round the outside of the building.
abstractions.illustrates: Proximity is not connection. Something can appear close and have no path to you at all, and only checking for the door tells them apart.

abstractions.measured: With every coupling at zero the metric returns distance 0.000000 — a completely dead mesh measures as PERFECTLY CONTRACTED, identical to a perfectly coupled one.
abstractions.figure: A room so dark that everything seems to be touching you.
abstractions.illustrates: Total absence of connection can read, from inside, exactly like total connection. The two are told apart by checking, not by how it feels.

abstractions.measured: Fidelity falls with lineage depth: Spearman ρ = −0.75 over 40 simulated swarms.
abstractions.figure: A message passed down a long line of people arrives thinner than it left, and each retelling costs something.
abstractions.illustrates: What is inherited attenuates. Distance from the source is not neutral, and nothing preserves itself by being passed on.

abstractions.measured: Capacity buys reach and nothing else: ρ(U, descendants) = +0.34, ρ(U, fidelity received) = −0.01.
abstractions.figure: A loud voice gathers a bigger crowd and does not, by being loud, receive a truer account of anything.
abstractions.illustrates: Reach and soundness are separate quantities. Growing the first has no effect on the second, which is why counting an audience measures the wrong thing.

abstractions.measured: Removing the root's outbound coupling leaves 200 of 200 descendants at infinite distance — every one of them, immediately.
abstractions.figure: Cut the trunk and every branch is still a branch, still shaped like a branch, and connected to nothing.
abstractions.illustrates: A structure entirely dependent on one source does not degrade gracefully when the source is withdrawn. It is intact and inert at the same moment.

abstractions.measured: D is the PRODUCT of two hops, encode and decode. Across the swarm cohort mean D falls from 0.838 at the first remove to 0.014 at the 39th.
abstractions.figure: Speaking through a wall and being heard through a wall. Neither wall has to be thick; two thin ones multiply.
abstractions.illustrates: Transmission has two sides and they compound rather than add. Saying it well does not survive being received badly, and a fault on either side is a fault in the whole.

abstractions.measured: The accelerating law E = U·D² was pre-registered and LOST: on 992 real repositories the linear law reaches AUC ~0.73 and the quadratic ~0.59 under cross-validation. Four cohorts out of four: the plain law was enough.
abstractions.value: QUADRATIC DISCONFIRMED (linear AUC ~0.73, quad CV AUC ~0.59, VIF 1.003)
abstractions.figure: Expecting that effort rewards itself faster and faster, and finding it only ever pays what it pays.
abstractions.illustrates: A hope for acceleration is worth writing down before looking, precisely so that it can be given up. Nothing in the record improves by being wished at.

abstractions.measured: A dataset counts as a valid test only if the two hops come from physically distinct measurements (VIF < 5). Yeast passes at 1.003; SEC EDGAR fails at 6.4 and its outcome is circular.
abstractions.figure: Two witnesses who turn out to have been standing together the whole time. There was only ever one account.
abstractions.illustrates: Independence is a property of how testimony was OBTAINED, not of how much of it there is. Agreement between two things that share a source is not corroboration.

abstractions.measured: A test is only valid if the failing region is populated: at least 100 real cases where the outcome did NOT occur. The GitHub cohort splits 750 fail / 242 survive.
abstractions.figure: Asking only the people who arrived how they found the road.
abstractions.illustrates: A claim that has never been given the chance to come out false has not been examined. The ones who did not make it have to be in the count.

abstractions.measured: The knowledge cohort passed every validity gate and the effect was still weak: AUC 0.58-0.62 on N=793, with a time confound recorded rather than removed.
abstractions.value: WEAK (AUC 0.58-0.62; newest-first time confound) — honest scope
abstractions.figure: A properly conducted search that finds very little, written up at exactly the size it was.
abstractions.illustrates: Doing the procedure correctly does not entitle anyone to a result. A small finding reported small is worth more than the same finding reported large.
